Returned in several cases: (1) SOAP message validation is turned on and validation errors are found; the response body is a list of error strings. (2) The response does not exist for the computed dispatch criteria; the response body is a string message 'The response %s does not exist!'.

Returned in several cases: (1) The service with the given name and version does not exist; the response body is a string message 'The service %s with version %s does not exist!'. (2) The dispatcher is not supported; the response body is a string message 'The dispatch %s is not supported!'. (3) The operation does not exist; the response body is a string message 'The operation %s does not exist!'.
Returned when SOAP message validation is turned on but the service does not have a WSDL resource; the response body is a string message 'The service %s with version %s does not have a wsdl!'.
Returned when the response is marked as a fault; the response body is the rendered response content.
